name: Windrunner
desc: The Windrunner is a Celtor NPC. They uncap the Agility stat. They are very hard to reach without major mobility.
additional_info:
-   In their dialogue, they talk about "The Contractor that resides within the Palace" and "the Warmaster in his Fortress" referring to [The Lord Regent](entity:the_lord_regent) and [Warden Jericho](entity:warden_jericho).
-   They have green eyes.
-   The Windrunner in name is likely a reference to the _Order of Windrunners_ from the _Stormlight Archives_ given other inspirations from the novels prevalent in Deepwoken. (https://coppermind.net/wiki/Order_of_Windrunners)
